request.business_problem: Sales reps type messy call notes and forget to update the CRM, so follow-ups are missed.
request.tasks: Turn raw call notes into structured CRM fields (contact, stage, roof type, budget, objections, next step with date) and draft a follow-up email for the rep to send.
request.required_output: CRM field block, next-step list with dates, and a follow-up email draft under 150 words.
request.examples: Notes: 'spoke w/ Dana Ruiz, 2-storey, tile roof, worried about cost, wants quote by fri, bills ~$240/mo'

smoke.prompt: Turn these call notes into CRM fields: 'Talked to Mark Obi, flat roof, wants battery too, budget around 18k, will decide after talking to his wife, call back Tuesday.'
